articles.explain: Indices like the DJIA (Dow Jones Industrial Average), S&P 500, and NASDAQ are major US stock market benchmarks. Their performance often sets the tone for global markets, including India, because investors look at how the largest companies in the world are performing to gauge global economic health.

story.title: Indian Stock Market Volatility
story.so_far: The Indian market is currently navigating a period of volatility driven by both global trends and domestic factors. Investors track indices like the Nifty and individual heavyweights like Reliance to gauge the overall direction of the market.

timeline.text: Increased geopolitical tension and high crude prices led to a loss of approximately ₹21 lakh crore in investor wealth.
timeline.source: mint - markets

timeline.text: Large-cap firms like HDFC Bank and Bajaj Finance faced significant valuation losses as the BSE Sensex plummeted.
timeline.source: Markets-Economic Times

timeline.text: The Nifty 50 and Sensex closed 0.68% and 0.66% higher respectively, following a sharp intra-day recovery.
timeline.source: mint - markets

timeline.text: GIFT Nifty futures are down, signaling a potential downward start for Sensex and Nifty as the market digests global trends and the Jio Platforms listing.
timeline.source: mint - markets

timeline.text: Futures data suggests a positive opening for Indian indices, supported by broader regional market trends.
timeline.source: mint - markets

timeline.text: Market analysts have highlighted a list of companies to watch on Friday based on their recent performance and market influence.
timeline.source: mint - markets

timeline.text: The Nifty 50 recovered slightly to 23,053, while smaller-cap stocks faced selling pressure, dropping up to 2%.
timeline.source: Markets-Economic Times

timeline.text: Asset managers believe recent foreign investor outflows are temporary and do not signal a structural decline in India's growth prospects.
timeline.source: Markets-Economic Times
